name: ism-no-cluster-admin-binding

provenance.rationale: The upstream aggregated rule covers all bound subjects; the standalone local rule applies the same subject scope directly to RBAC bindings.

description: Fail RBAC bindings that grant the cluster-admin ClusterRole to any subject.
remediation: Remove cluster-admin and use a narrowly scoped Role or ClusterRole; review emergency access through the downstream exception process.
